laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: After an instruction ('Lees eers die sleutel'), 'dan' expresses the result that follows; 'nou' wrongly suggests the reader already did it (net 0 words).
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Nou weet jy' after an instruction is ordinary, natural instructional Afrikaans; 'Dan' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The next sentence says 'of jy reg geraai het', so switching from 'n mens to jy within two sentences is inconsistent; using jy throughout keeps the reference steady (net -1 word).
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Moving from the general ''n mens' to 'jy' within a paragraph is normal Afrikaans, and the generic sense (any reader) is what the sentence means; the proposal is only different.
